hypothesis: Existing Xe2 E=1 INT4 GEMM is a compatible faster prefill backend without changing policy or determinism
format_gate: exact exhaustive integer and dequantized weight equality; scalar int8 zero point 8; no g_idx; BF16 G128 contiguous scales; NT int32 packed weights

native_reference.reference: FP32 matmul of captured BF16 A and BF16 dequantized original weights, BF16 output; same as frozen grouped INT4 test

onednn_compatibility.reference: captured and replayed deterministic oneDNN output; existing two BF16-quanta batch-separability tolerance

gates.repeatability: bit exact fixed inputs/shapes under intervening changed operands, allocations and calls

batch_separability.shapes: M=4 vs 4xM=1, plus prefill vs independent rows

gates.ownership: finite complete output after NaN prefill; intact outer canaries; unchanged input operands

performance_if_correct: Include rows metadata, output/scratch allocation, launch and synchronization in paired reversed-order operator timings. Require weighted operator win and paired service TTFT gain > max(3%, twice measured control relative range), consistently across starts. Full service/memory/MTP2/image gates precede recommendation.
stop: Stop candidate GPU execution at first failed format/reference/repeatability/ownership gate; record unrun gates. No policy rewrite, deployment or release.
